articles.title: Jason Maurer Joins SL Green as Managing Director
articles.narrative: Jason Maurer has been appointed Managing Director at SL Green Realty, where he will be responsible for overseeing retail leasing across the company's portfolio and leading office leasing for Green Property Services, SL Green's third-party asset management platform. Maurer brings two decades of experience in retail and office leasing, having previously served as Executive Vice President and Head of Leasing for North America at Brookfield Properties (now BGRE). His expertise is expected to enhance SL Green's retail portfolio in New York and contribute to the growth of Green Property Services.

data_points.project_notes: Green Property Services operates across five buildings, totaling 1.3 million square feet as of late September.

articles.title: Greystone Refis Hollywood, Fla., Apartments With $109M Loan
articles.narrative: A joint venture between bti partners and Bridge Investment Group secured a $109 million Freddie Mac-backed loan from Greystone to refinance The Bread Building, a 362-unit multifamily property in Hollywood, FL. The sponsors acquired the former office building in 2021 for $11 million and completed its conversion to apartments in 2025. The property achieved full occupancy in September 2026, demonstrating strong market fundamentals and making it an excellent candidate for the cash-out refinance with full-term interest-only and 35-year amortization.

data_points.notable_features: The 25-story property includes approximately 17,000 square feet of retail space, 478 parking spaces, a swimming pool with cabanas, a sun deck, an outdoor kitchen, and a fitness center. It is located just south of ArtsPark at Young Circle, a 10-acre recreational green space.
data_points.project_notes: The property was previously the headquarters for Hollywood Bread Company and was acquired in 2021 for $11 million for redevelopment into apartments. The loan utilized Freddie Mac's Lease-Up Loan program.

articles.title: Lightstone Capital Provides $29.5M Loan for Orange, N.J., Multifamily Development
articles.narrative: PEEK Capital, a division of PEEK Properties, has secured a $29.5 million bridge loan from Lightstone Capital for its recently completed 102-unit multifamily project, The Lincoln, in Orange, NJ. The financing will support the building's lease-up and stabilization, as well as refinance its previous construction loan. The property, which received its certificate of occupancy in September, is strategically located near public transit, offering convenient access to Newark and Midtown Manhattan.

data_points.notable_features: Five-story, full-block apartment building located one block from NJ Transit's Highland Avenue station, offering access to Newark and Midtown Manhattan.
data_points.project_notes: Refinances a previous $20.5 million construction loan from Amboy Bank secured in 2024.

articles.market_intelligence: The cities of Orange and East Orange have been popular for luxury apartment development due to renters being priced out of New York City.

articles.title: AJ Capital Partners Lands $52M Refi for Princeton, N.J., Hotel
articles.narrative: AJ Capital Partners has secured a $52 million refinancing loan for its Graduate by Hilton Princeton hotel in Princeton, NJ. The loan, originated by GreenOak, has a three-year term with two 12-month extension options. The 180-room hotel is strategically located directly across from Princeton University, aligning with AJ Capital's strategy of developing hospitality properties near major higher education institutions.

data_points.notable_features: Located directly across from Princeton University.
data_points.project_notes: The financing comes with a three-year term and two 12-month extension options.

articles.title: Financial Tech Platform Intuit Takes 4K SF at the Orchard in LIC
articles.narrative: BLDG Management has secured three new retail leases totaling 7,468 square feet at The Orchard, Queens' tallest residential tower. Financial services platform Intuit signed a 3,546-square-foot lease, Japanese tea brand Mollytea took 1,671 square feet, and Korean beauty supplier Tokimo leased 2,251 square feet. The property, which is 90 percent leased residentially, aims to serve both its residents and the broader Long Island City neighborhood with its diverse offerings.

data_points.address: 42-06 Orchard Street, Long Island City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Queens' tallest residential tower with a 60,000-square-foot outdoor deck featuring a swimming pool, dog park, barbeque areas, and a running track.

articles.title: Toro Development Opens $560M Medley Mixed-Use Destination in Johns Creek, Georgia
articles.narrative: Toro Development Co. has officially opened Medley, a $560 million mixed-use destination in Johns Creek, Georgia. The 43-acre project includes 25 new restaurants and retailers, 112,000 square feet of office space that opened fully leased, and 881 luxury residences. A 150-room boutique hotel under Marriott's Tribute Portfolio is also planned to open in 2028.

data_points.address: 11650 Johns Creek Pkwy, Johns Creek, GA
data_points.notable_features: Includes a 25,000-square-foot plaza and a 150-room boutique hotel under Marriott's Tribute Portfolio.
data_points.project_notes: The site was formerly a suburban office campus for State Farm Insurance, which relocated in 2013. The office component was built on a speculative basis.

articles.title: CBRE Arranges $81M Construction Loan for Multifamily Development in Charlotte
articles.narrative: CBRE's Debt & Structured Finance team has secured an $81 million construction loan from Western-Southern Life Insurance Co. for the development of Sutherland at Piper Glen, a 299-unit multifamily project in Charlotte, NC. The borrower is a consortium of investors led by RK Investors, who is also the developer. This project will be a key residential component of the larger Greenway at Piper Glen master-planned development.

data_points.notable_features: Four five-story apartment buildings atop structured parking, with amenities including a fitness center, coworking spaces, golf simulator, swimming pool, and pet wash station.
data_points.project_notes: The property is the multifamily component of the Greenway at Piper Glen master-planned development.

articles.title: JLL Negotiates $32.5M Sale of Power Retail Center in Birmingham
articles.narrative: JLL has brokered the $32.5 million sale of the second phase of Village at Lee Branch, a power retail center in Birmingham, AL. Atlanta-based Cygnus Capital sold the 83 percent leased property to Richmond-based Hackney Real Estate Partners. The center is strategically located along U.S. Highway 280 in the Meadowbrook submarket.

data_points.property_name: Village at Lee Branch, Phase II
data_points.notable_features: Located in the Meadowbrook submarket along U.S. Highway 280; adjacent to the first phase of Village at Lee Branch, which is anchored by Publix.

articles.title: Matthews Brokers Sale of Magnolia Marketplace Shopping Center in New Orleans
articles.narrative: Matthews has brokered the sale of Magnolia Marketplace, a 115,281-square-foot shopping center in New Orleans. Stirling Properties sold the fully leased asset to Agree Realty. While the sales price was not disclosed, the transaction represents the highest retail sales price in New Orleans' Mid-City/Central City submarket in the last decade, according to CoStar Group data.

data_points.address: 2900 S. Claiborne Ave., New Orleans, LA
data_points.project_notes: Stirling Properties is retaining ownership of an outparcel at the center.

articles.market_intelligence: The deal marks the highest sales price for a retail property sold within New Orleans’ Mid-City/Central City submarket within the past 10 years, according to data from CoStar Group.

articles.title: SEG Solar Acquires Two Manufacturing Buildings Totaling 1.1 MSF in Tomball, Texas
articles.narrative: SEG Solar has acquired two manufacturing buildings totaling 1.1 million square feet within Northwest 99 Business Park in Tomball, a northwestern suburb of Houston. Building 2, spanning 450,320 square feet, is being converted into a solar module manufacturing facility, while the 704,080-square-foot Building 3 will support distribution operations. This acquisition expands SEG Solar's presence in the park, following its purchase of Building 1 in 2025.

data_points.notable_features: Buildings 2 and 3 are under construction, with Building 2 planned for conversion into a solar module manufacturing facility and Building 3 for distribution operations.
data_points.project_notes: SEG Solar previously acquired Building 1, a 425,360-square-foot facility, within the same business park in 2025.

articles.title: Cushman & Wakefield adds director in Dallas-Fort Worth office
articles.narrative: Joe Tyner has been appointed as Director in Cushman & Wakefield's Dallas-Fort Worth office. In this role, Tyner will focus on leveraging his expertise in land and development to assist clients with strategic real estate solutions, including the acquisition, disposition, and evaluation of land for industrial development. His background in land sales and site selection is expected to enhance the firm's capabilities in serving clients across the region.

articles.title: Chicago’s W.E. O’Neil Construction appoints general counsel
Marcus & Millichap closes $2.4 million self-storage sale in Janesville
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has facilitated the sale of Crosby Avenue Self Storage, a 282-unit self-storage facility in Janesville, Wisconsin, for $2.4 million. The property, which was nearly fully occupied at the time of sale, was acquired by an out-of-state buyer from a local owner.

articles.title: St. Louis’ S.M. Wilson & Co. adds K-12 education construction consultant
articles.narrative: S. M. Wilson & Co. has appointed Will Perkins as K-12 Education Construction Consultant, a strategic move to enhance its engagement with school districts across Missouri. Perkins, with 31 years of experience in public education and a strong background in school administration and superintendency, will focus on introducing the company and assisting districts with their capital project planning. His expertise in budgeting, bond issues, and community campaigns for school projects is expected to be a significant asset.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap brokers sale of 42-unit multifamily property in Saint Johns
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap brokered the sale of Sturgis Crossings, a 42-unit multifamily property in Saint Johns, Michigan. The firm also arranged acquisition financing for the buyer through its capital corporation subsidiary. The loan features a 10-year term, a 6.3% interest rate, and 25-year amortization.

data_points.address: 900 E. Sturgis St., Saint Johns, MI

articles.financing: Acquisition financing with a 10-year term, 6.3% interest rate, 6 months of interest-only payments, and 25-year amortization.

articles.title: Walmart Advancing $400M San Antonio-Area Distribution Center
articles.narrative: Walmart is proceeding with a $400 million distribution center in Cibolo, a suburb of San Antonio, Texas. The 744,000-square-foot facility is expected to break ground early next year and be completed by the third quarter of 2029. The city of Cibolo has approved significant tax abatements and rebates, totaling approximately $32.5 million, to support the project.

data_points.address: 3641 S. Santa Clara Road, Cibolo, TX
data_points.notable_features: Located on the former San Antonio Raceway site along Interstate 10.
data_points.project_notes: The city approved a 75% property tax abatement for 10 years and a 50% rebate of maintenance and operations property tax for 5 years, along with a performance-based sales tax, totaling approximately $32.5 million in tax breaks. A tax increment reinvestment zone was also established.

articles.market_intelligence: The industrial submarket in Guadalupe County has an industrial vacancy rate of 5% as of September.

articles.title: ARCTRUST, Edison Equity Teaming Up on 175-Unit Austin-Area 55+ Community
articles.narrative: ARCTRUST Private Capital and Edison Equity Residential have broken ground on Serenova at Dripping Springs, a 175-unit, age-restricted community in Dripping Springs, TX. The project secured a construction loan from North River Partners in August. The community will feature a mix of apartment homes and private villas, with first residents anticipated in Fall 2028.

data_points.notable_features: 55+ age-restricted community, located adjacent to the Headwaters master-planned community, offering concierge services and amenities including a chef-curated restaurant, fitness centers, pool, and creative arts studio.

articles.title: RCG Ventures Picks Up 207K-SF Tucker Retail Center
articles.narrative: RCG Ventures has acquired the 207,000-square-foot Tucker Meridian Shopping Center in Tucker, Georgia, from Ben F. Kushner Company. The grocery-anchored retail center, developed in 2015 on the site of a former office park, was nearly fully occupied at the time of sale. This acquisition aligns with RCG Ventures' strategy of investing in multi-tenant, anchored shopping centers with long-term ownership potential.

data_points.project_notes: Site was previously an office park, demolished in 2015 for this retail development.

articles.title: Renowned Flagler Commercial Corner Hits the Market
articles.narrative: A historic 52,500-square-foot mixed-use property in Downtown Miami, originally built in 1937 and recently renovated in 2024, has been listed for sale with an asking price of $33 million. The distinctive building offers a diverse mix of retail, hospitality, office, and entertainment spaces, presenting significant opportunities for a new owner to enhance net operating income through strategic lease-up and tenant repositioning. The property also benefits from a pending 10-year property tax abatement.

data_points.notable_features: Features a ground-floor food hall, hospitality infrastructure on the second and third floors, unfinished space on the fourth floor, completed office/coworking on the fifth floor, and a rooftop designated for a Japanese fire kitchen. Includes a basement entertainment concept and commissary kitchen.
data_points.project_notes: Renovated in 2024. Pending 10-year property tax abatement.

articles.title: Battered Mortgage REIT Suspends Dividend To Preserve Cash
articles.narrative: A mortgage REIT reported a significant loss of $85.4 million in the third quarter, exacerbating its year-to-date losses. The company attributed these financial difficulties to rising debt costs, which are placing considerable pressure on borrowers. In response to these challenges and to safeguard its liquidity, the REIT has decided to suspend its dividend.

articles.title: Dan Wagner To Head Lee & Associates In Atlanta: The Atlanta Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Dan Wagner has been appointed as the new head of Lee & Associates' Atlanta office, succeeding Dave Howard, who will transition into a consulting role. This leadership change marks a significant transition for the Atlanta branch of the commercial real estate firm.

articles.title: GGP To Redevelop Former Dick's Sporting Goods Store At Frisco's Stonebriar Centre
articles.narrative: GGP, the owner of Stonebriar Centre in Frisco, TX, plans to redevelop a former anchor store into an outdoor dining and entertainment area. This initiative aims to enhance the mall's appeal by integrating new restaurant concepts within a vibrant outdoor setting.

data_points.notable_features: Redevelopment of a former anchor store into an outdoor area surrounded by restaurants.

articles.title: From Pandemic Darling To Cautionary Tale: Pickleball Clubs Face A Reckoning After Betting Big On Retail Space
articles.narrative: The pickleball industry, which experienced rapid expansion during the pandemic, is now facing significant challenges, exemplified by The Picklr's recent bankruptcy filing. This downturn suggests a potential reckoning for clubs that aggressively expanded into retail spaces, as the market becomes increasingly competitive and saturated.
